value.rationale: The ten-vertex crown is the first non-cube matching-deleted balanced biclique, and the ordinary fourth cut is the first new adjacent threshold beyond established crown three-cut work. Its exact 26-four-sphere integral homotopy type, as opposed to just homology, exhibits non-shellability of a pure 5-complex; the verified acyclic matching is a substantive finite structural certificate for a natural graph parameter, not an arbitrary invariant.
